description.value: A Township of Langley municipal recreation centre located in the Brookswood neighbourhood, featuring an ice arena, the Langley Curling Centre, and an outdoor sports box. The facility also houses The Lodge Steakhouse and The Horse & Ryder Pub, making it a potential rest stop with on-site dining options. Room rentals and a large parking lot are available.
